title: lepisorus thunbergianus
intro: Lepisorus thunbergianus, commonly known as Thunberg's fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Athyriaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various ailments due to its rich health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lepisorus thunbergianus include its anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative properties, making it a potential remedy for several chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
